title: Fruits
simplified_paragraphs: 妹妹喜欢吃水果。她的生日快到了，哥哥和姐姐一起去山上找好吃的水果给妹妹。
一个小时以后，姐姐找到了很多水果，哥哥只有一个水果。
姐姐问哥哥：你怎么只找到一个？
哥哥说：好吃的水果很多，但我只要一个最好吃的就可以了。
姐姐笑哥哥说：那么多好吃的水果，你都不要。
可是，下山的路上，姐姐觉得水果太多太重了，得拿一些水果出来。
最后，回到家，姐姐也只有一个水果了。

最後，回到家，姐姐也只有一個水果了。
pinyin_paragraphs: mèi mei xǐ huan chī shuǐ guǒ。 tā de shēng rì kuài dào le， gē ge hé jiě jie yī qǐ qù shān shàng zhǎo hǎo chī de shuǐ guǒ gěi mèi mei。
yī gè xiǎo shí yǐ hòu， jiě jie zhǎo dào le hěn duō shuǐ guǒ， gē ge zhǐ yǒu yī gè shuǐ guǒ。
jiě jie wèn gē ge： nǐ zěn me zhǐ zhǎo dào yī gè？
gē ge shuō： hǎo chī de shuǐ guǒ hěn duō， dàn wǒ zhǐ yào yī gè zuì hǎo chī de jiù kě yǐ le。
jiě jie xiào gē ge shuō： nà me duō hǎo chī de shuǐ guǒ， nǐ dōu bù yào。
kě shì， xià shān de lù shang， jiě jie jué de shuǐ guǒ tài duō tài zhòng le， děi ná yī xiē shuǐ guǒ chu lai。
zuì hòu， huí dào jiā， jiě jie yě zhǐ yǒu yī gè shuǐ guǒ le。
english_paragraphs: The little sister loved eating fruit. Her birthday was coming soon, so her older brother and sister went up the mountain together to find some tasty fruit for her.
An hour later, the older sister had found lots of fruit, but the older brother had only found one piece.
The older sister asked him, “How come you only found one?”
He said, “There’s lots of tasty fruit, but I only need the tastiest one.”
The older sister laughed at him. “There’s so much tasty fruit, and you don’t want any of it!”
But on the way down the mountain, she found that all the fruit was too heavy, so she had to take some out.
In the end, when they got home, the older sister had only one piece of fruit too.
english_full:
The little sister loved eating fruit. Her birthday was coming soon, so her older brother and sister went up the mountain together to find some tasty fruit for her.

An hour later, the older sister had found lots of fruit, but the older brother had only found one piece.

The older sister asked him, “How come you only found one?”

He said, “There’s lots of tasty fruit, but I only need the tastiest one.”

The older sister laughed at him. “There’s so much tasty fruit, and you don’t want any of it!”

But on the way down the mountain, she found that all the fruit was too heavy, so she had to take some out.

In the end, when they got home, the older sister had only one piece of fruit too.
